description: Create a TASK in the connected project — what Tasks → Create Task does — and return its key (TS-xx / TA-xx). Needs `name` and `estimatedEffort` (hours); everything else is optional and DEFAULTED, and the answer lists what was defaulted: type / state / priority = the project's own default values, planned dates = the sprint's (else the release's, else today). Optional: `description`, `assignee` (email, name, user id or "me" — one that matches nobody is refused), `releaseId` / `sprintId` (id, code or exact name; a sprint brings its release and must belong to the release named), `storyId` (the user story it belongs to: id or key), `type`, `state`, `priority`, `plannedStartDate` / `plannedEndDate` (YYYY-MM-DD). A task with the same name in the project is refused. Reads the task back. Needs the add_task privilege. Change it later with task_update.

assignee.description: Email, name, numeric user id or "me". Default: unassigned.

releaseId.description: Release: id, code (RE-44) or exact name.

sprintId.description: Sprint: id, code (SP-1) or exact name; it must belong to the release.

storyId.description: User story it belongs to: id or key (US_123).

type.description: Task type — one of the project's own; default: the project's default type.

name: task_create
title: Create a task
